rootCause.mechanism: the afterAll check enumerated EVERY entry of the per-user OS tmpdir() starting with HARNESS_SCRATCH_PREFIX ('nwf-pe-tier2-batch-') and required that set to equal the file's own beforeAll snapshot. It therefore asserted on directories this file did not own.
rootCause.correctionToTheStatedDiagnosis: the diagnosis handed to this step named another PARALLEL VITEST FILE as the concurrent writer. That is not possible inside one run of this repository: vitest.config.ts sets fileParallelism: false, so test files run serially. The concurrent writer is another PROCESS sharing the same per-user tmpdir. The ownership defect, and the fix, are the same either way.
